result.summary: The street is a wide, multi-lane thoroughfare with narrow sidewalks and significant on-street parking that creates visual obstructions. There is a complete lack of visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures, making the environment hostile for those on foot.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway lacks any mid-block crossing or refuge, forcing pedestrians to cross a long distance unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkways
hazards.description: The sidewalks are narrow and lack a buffer from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway and a large commercial gas station with an undefined, continuous driveway apron that creates a significant conflict zone. While sidewalks are present in front of adjacent residential structures, the lack of crossing infrastructure and the expansive vehicle access points make the area hostile for walking.

hazards.name: Continuous Driveway Apron
hazards.description: The gas station frontage lacks a defined curb, allowing vehicles to enter and exit across the entire sidewalk path at unpredictable angles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background, spanning the width of the gas station property

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway lacks any mid-block crossing infrastructure or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to cross four or more lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lanes or parking without a planting strip or physical barrier to protect pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the street in front of the row houses

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Curbing
interventions.description: Install curbing along the gas station frontage to define specific, narrow entry and exit points, restoring a protected sidewalk path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings and potentially a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB).

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with sidewalks on both sides and a signalized intersection in the distance. Large parked vehicles create significant visual obstructions between the sidewalk and the travel lanes, and the lack of mid-block crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large trucks and SUVs parked along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right and left curbs in the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Crossing
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration results in a long crossing distance at the intersection, increasing exposure time to traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to a row of mixed-use buildings with no buffer from the roadway. Significant physical and visual obstructions are present due to a large van parked on or very close to the walkway, forcing pedestrians into potential conflict with traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: A large white van is parked in a manner that appears to block or severely narrow the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center, in front of the Four Sister Food Market

hazards.name: Visual Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking, including high-profile vehicles, blocks the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line across the center of the frame

interventions.title: Sidewalk Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or heavy planters to prevent vehicles from parking on or encroaching upon the narrow sidewalk space.
